caseload.title: Caseload Overview
caseload.independentBody: Missing dimensions are unweighted and isolated. Circumstance disclosures remain protected under the institutional data charter and are never imputed from academic signals.
caseload.searchPlaceholder: Search advisee by student name, ID or programme

profile.auditProtocolBody: Read access to this student record is written to the institutional cryptographic ledger under audit scope {scope}.
profile.ledgerSubtitle: Committed notes, logged referrals and formal determinations are permanent. Corrections are submitted as append-only addenda.

evidence.title: Evidence Verification & Audit
evidence.subtitle: Attendance & in-person telemetry evidence
evidence.noticeBody: This indicator may change when more evidence becomes available. Telemetry is subject to asynchronous sensor batch ingestion, hardware connectivity logs and formal departmental corrections.
evidence.calculationEngineValue: Attendance v1 — in-person scheduled contact hours attended ÷ eligible scheduled hours.
evidence.primarySourceValue: Biometric RFID turnstile and room sensor telemetry.
evidence.correctionBody: A correction effective 3 September was recorded on 7 September 2026 at 11:15 ICT. The CS301 lab session on 2 September was initially flagged as an unexcused absence because reader CAM-GATE-09 was offline during maintenance. Departmental reconciliation verified the manual sign-in roster and updated effective attendance to 90.0%. The original record was not overwritten.
evidence.completenessCaption: Primary campus RFID and biometric feeds integrated. Off-campus and clinical logs are unintegrated or withheld.
evidence.sourcesUsedTitle: Sources used — permitted for academic advising

case.protocolTitle: Institutional advising ledger — immutable record protocol
case.protocolBody: Committed notes, recorded contacts, referrals and academic triage decisions cannot be modified or purged. Revisions are appended as numbered addenda under supervisory oversight.
case.emptyActionBody: Active cases should retain an agreed milestone so that a review point exists in the record.
case.draftsCaption: Not visible to the institutional audit ledger

note.draftSavedAt: Draft auto-saved locally at {time} · {edits} edits captured
note.localOnlyTitle: Draft in progress — local workspace only
note.localOnlyBody: Notes recorded here do not enter the institutional ledger until they are formally signed and committed. On commitment this record becomes permanently read-only; revisions can only be appended as numbered addenda.
note.categoryHint: Select the institutional archetype that determines the statutory retention tier.
note.observationsCriteria: Describe objective factual findings, student statements and verified telemetry context before proceeding.
note.observationsHint: Record objective, factual statements and verified academic observations. Do not include unconsented sensitive personal attributes.
note.actionPlanHint: Action plans become enforceable advisory undertakings within the faculty monitoring cycle.
note.integrityBody: AdviseCare prohibits algorithmic auto-writing and automated consequential advice. Every note and agreed action reflects direct human consultation and professional advisor judgement.
note.protectedBody: Reference this token in the rationale rather than copying confidential welfare statements into the ledger. Unrelated circumstances stay outside the purpose boundary.
note.appendNotice: The new note will append directly after this immutable entry once committed.

review.title: Review & commit note
review.state: Review state — verification prior to ledger commitment
review.preCommitBody: Once committed, this note is permanently appended to the institutional advising ledger. Edits and retroactive deletions are prohibited by governance; any future modification requires a signed superseding addendum that references this transaction hash.
review.failureTitle: Ledger commit interrupted — gateway timeout reaching the ledger node
review.failureBody: The draft is safe and intact in local storage; no data was lost. The target verification node did not acknowledge the write pipeline within the 10.0s quorum limit.
review.section2: Section 2: agreed action plan & next steps
review.immutabilityNotice: Record immutability: on signature, edit and delete capabilities are disengaged at the database layer.
review.draftUnlocked: The draft remains unlocked until commit is invoked.

decisionTime.title: Record at decision time
decisionTime.directiveTitle: Historical view — current access permissions still apply
decisionTime.directiveBody: Viewing records at a past temporal coordinate reconstructs the state of knowledge at the moment a decision was made. It does not bypass active privacy boundaries, consent authorisations or role-based purpose limits: everything withheld today stays withheld here.
decisionTime.reconstructionSubtitle: Two time axes, kept separate so that later corrections cannot rewrite what the advisor knew.
decisionTime.axisA: Time axis A — real-world effective time (valid time)
decisionTime.axisABody: When the academic circumstance, interaction or threshold breach actually happened in the institution.
decisionTime.axisB: Time axis B — system transaction time (known to system)
decisionTime.axisBBody: When the immutable ledger recorded the event. What was not written at this instant could not have been known by the advisor.
decisionTime.necessityBody: Post-facto revisions — late medical certificates, turnstile repairs — must never erase or distort the evidential record that justified a formal academic action.
decisionTime.deltaTitle: Evidence delta: decision point versus current state
decisionTime.snapshotCaption: Known to the system and the advisor at {timestamp}
decisionTime.currentCaption: Status recorded following hardware calibration on {timestamp}
decisionTime.nonOverwritingBody: The 90.0% correction recorded on 7 Sep is retroactively effective from 3 Sep. Under audit rules it must not replace the 85.0% evidence that was actively known to the advisor on the decision date. Both states are preserved.
decisionTime.appendOnlyPolicyBody: This entry was sealed into the university archive at commit time. It cannot be modified or purged; subsequent corrections are affixed only as sequential superseding addenda.

consentRequest.title: Consent scope request
consentRequest.stagingSubtitle: Configure granular scope boundaries before dispatch to the student.
consentRequest.protocolTitle: Consent scope authorisation protocol — student agency guarantee
consentRequest.protocolBody: Submitting a request does not unlock or reveal any protected data. Every disclosure requires an affirmative, unforced authorisation by the student in their own portal. Advisors can track lifecycle status but cannot grant, override or proxy consent.
consentRequest.zeroDisclosure: Zero-disclosure notice rule: the student receives only a generic notification (“New consent request pending your review”) containing no sensitive detail.
consentRequest.step2Hint: The student retains an individual veto on each attribute.
consentRequest.antiBlanket: Under the anti-blanket directive each proposed attribute is authorised individually. The student may consent to one attribute while declining another.
consentRequest.step5Hint: Visible in full to the student in their portal.
consentRequest.linkedNote: Linked to immutable advising log NOTE-002
consentRequest.dispatchNotice: Dispatch commits this record to the immutable audit stream.
consentRequest.dispatchedBody: A generic student notice is queued. Initial state set to pending student review. Zero attributes disclosed.
consentRequest.separationBody: Advisors have no mechanical privilege to self-grant scope. No raw data is visible before the student acts.
consentRequest.affirmationBody: The default state is absolute refusal. Data is disclosed only after a positive action.
consentRequest.splitBody: The student may grant one attribute and decline another independently.
consentRequest.revocationBody: The student may terminate any granted scope instantly, with no penalty and no review delay.

postWithdrawal.stateBody: Consent CONS-001 was withdrawn by the student on 8 Sep 2026 at 10:00 ICT. Edge access was severed in 134 ms and the protected payload was destroyed. The decision record that relied on it is unchanged.
postWithdrawal.noScopeTitle: No consented circumstance scope is active
postWithdrawal.noScopeBody: There is nothing to display for this section. No value is masked, no placeholder is shown and no request control is rendered — an absent attribute looks absent.
postWithdrawal.whatRemainsBody: The consent grant CG-4990 remains in the registry with its state set to WITHDRAWN, together with its evidence hash and the erasure receipt. The value it protected does not.

erasure.title: Historical record after erasure
erasure.erasedTitle: Protected value erased after consent withdrawal
erasure.erasedBody: The decision and its evidence references remain. This protected value can no longer be displayed.
erasure.erasedDetail: Category ATTR-FIN-001 (financial circumstances). Consent CONS-001 was revoked by the advisee on 08-SEP-2026 10:00 ICT under withdrawal receipt RCPT-WDR-89012. Key material was destroyed and the payload nullified across bitemporal caches.

correction.title: Correction review: attendance telemetry
correction.protocolBody: Accepting a correction does not edit, overwrite or mutate the original telemetry or archived notes. Acceptance appends a reconciled fact version with explicit valid-time and transaction-time anchors, while permanently preserving the original record, the student's submission provenance and the prior advising decisions.
correction.deltaSubtitle: Telemetry module: gate sensor RFID turnstile ingestion
correction.guaranteeBody: No operation edits or removes a historical record. Approving writes an append-only reconciliation block. Rejecting retains the original status and archives your formal explanation permanently.

referral.title: New welfare referral
referral.protocolTitle: Minimum-necessary welfare hand-off & consent boundary protocol
referral.protocolBody: Referrals route strictly to designated Student Welfare Officers under the isolated purpose Welfare Support. Academic status and diagnostic data are filtered out by policy default. Committed referrals cannot be edited or erased; subsequent factual corrections require an official addendum.
referral.triageRationaleBody: Persistent attendance friction stemming from a housing relocation; structured caseworker outreach is needed before the term week 04 census. No acute safety risk is presented.
referral.assistanceNotice: Entries to this record are indexed into the official university archive upon commitment.
referral.minimumNecessaryBody: Payloads transferred to the Student Welfare Office are restricted to items for which the student holds an explicit, active consent token bound to this specific purpose.
referral.quarantineBody: Unavailable for the welfare support purpose — scope not consented. This attribute cannot be copied into the referral payload.
referral.draftHint: You can save this referral draft and request student consent without blocking referral creation. Silently broadening access is prohibited.
referral.summaryCaption: Audit representation of the immutable dispatch package. Inspect the parameters before recording.

emergency.title: Emergency access request
emergency.protocolBody: Emergency requisitions do not grant instantaneous break-glass disclosure. Every requisition is quarantined and dispatched to an independent Data Protection Steward on the on-call roster. Requester self-approval is cryptographically locked and barred.
emergency.stewardReady: Steward on-call ready — pool of 3 independent officers
emergency.ruleBody: Current credentials permit review of enrolled course registers, attendance and timetable friction logs under the academic advising purpose. Isolation boundaries block access to residential tenancy records, transit alerts and medical case indices.
emergency.requisitionCaption: Statutory exception requisition under University Charter 14.4
emergency.purposeBody: Restricted to coordinating campus transit, emergency accommodation liaison and rescheduling compulsory laboratory and examination sessions. Precludes disciplinary or punitive action.
emergency.archiveNotice: Official university archive notice: indexed into the cryptographic audit trail.
emergency.acknowledgement: I acknowledge that submitting this request generates an indelible record in the audit ledger, that no self-approval can be executed, and that all requested attribute data remain firewalled and inaccessible until an independent Data Protection Steward signs off.
emergency.pendingBody: Request lodged and assigned to the on-call Data Protection Steward. Notice dispatched via the institutional paging channel.
emergency.zeroLeak: Zero data leak invariant: 0 bytes revealed. Break-glass bypass disabled by policy.

timeLimited.title: Time-limited access
timeLimited.invariantBody: An ephemeral hardware-backed token is armed. When the exception expires this view automatically revokes the decryption keys and replaces the permitted value with “Unavailable — exception expired”. A rejected requisition retains the original denied view and its decision reason. Erased data stays permanently unreachable.

lists.casesSubtitle: Every open and closed case owned by this advisor for the current term.
lists.consentSubtitle: Lifecycle status only. Advisors can track a request but cannot grant, override or proxy consent.
lists.correctionsSubtitle: Rectification is append-only: an upheld correction adds an addendum and never overwrites the original record.
lists.referralsSubtitle: Each referral names the consent grant that made the disclosure lawful.
lists.emergencySubtitle: Requests are mediated by an independent steward. Nothing is disclosed before a decision is signed.
